name: sendSecureMessage
shortDescription: Manages sending encrypted messages between patients and doctors, ensuring auditable communication and webhook notifications.
description:
Overview

Manages the sending and encryption of messages between patients and their assigned doctors, ensuring auditable communication. It also triggers a webhook notification to external systems upon message creation.

Intended use

Called by the secure messaging UI when a patient or doctor sends a new message. The parameters include sender ID, receiver ID, conversation ID, and message content. It returns the created message record or an error if sending fails.

Logic

  1. Validate the input parameters, ensuring valid sender, receiver, and message content.
  2. Verify that the sender and receiver are authorized to communicate (e.g., assigned doctor-patient relationship).
  3. Encrypt the message content before persistence.
  4. Create a new Message record using ctx.data.create, setting encryptionStatus to 'encrypted'.
  5. Construct a payload with message details and send a webhook notification to the WebhookService using ctx.service('WebhookService').send_notification.
  6. Audit-log the message sending with ctx.audit.log, including sender, receiver, and message ID.
  7. Return the created message record.

Entities

  • Message
  • User

External Services

  • WebhookService
